alex: Quick sync — I'm going to run a short docs prune sweep for our 429/timeouts/context-limit pages. Found ~12 orphaned links, 3 SDK snippets still using the old `X-Retry-After` example, and one runbook anchor that jumps to the wrong heading. Goal: batch fixes + follow-up PRs and close by EOW. Who can take link fixes vs snippet updates?

maya: I can take the link fixes. I'll grep for `errref` and the stale anchors, then open PRs. planning to do a shallow link-only pass first.

sam: I can handle SDK snippet updates (python/js/curl). Quick question — do we standardize on showing `Retry-After` + example backoff, or prefer the SDK-level retry helper snippets?

alex: Good Q. Prefer showing both where relevant: a minimal curl example with `Retry-After` and then a short SDK snippet that uses our retry helper (so readers see both the wire and the recommended code).

katie: Also add a tiny test note in the runbook: repro steps to produce a synthetic 429 in staging (small-flood + inject short rate-limit rule). Example: run a k6 script or `ab` against the test endpoint, assert `429` and `Retry-After` header present. Saves time for support.

sam: Copy. I'll update snippets and include a short ex backoff sample. Draft snippet (will paste into PR):
```python
# pseudo-example: simple exponential backoff for 429
import time
for i in range(5):
    resp = client.generate(payload)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        sleep = min(2 ** i, 30)
        time.sleep(sleep)
        continue
    break
```

sam: And curl example for the wire: `curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` — show `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` and `Retry-After: 5` header.

maya: FYI I already tracked two suspicious anchors in `docs/troubleshooting/err-ref.md` and `docs/runbooks/timeout-playbook.md`. I'll open a link-only PR first so we can merge quickly.

alex: Nice. Please add the `errref-prune` label to link PRs and `sdk-snippet` label to snippet PRs. Also add a short changelog line: "fixes: stale anchors + retry examples" for release notes.

deploy-bot: docsite: deploy queued for branch `maya/link-cleanup` — preview at https://deploy-previews.redwood.test/preview/7745 :eyes:

maya: opened GH PRs: #9012 (link-only fixes) and #9013 (anchor corrections). Assigning @katie for runbook anchor sanity.

sam: opened GH PR #9014 for SDK snippet updates + unit example. Putting `README-snippets` test to assert snippet builds.

katie: Quick checklist suggestion before merging: 1) link-only PR passes linkcheck, 2) snippet PR includes runnable snippet or CI guard, 3) runbook anchor cross-links verified, 4) add tiny repro note to runbook. I'll review link PRs today.

alex: Perfect. After merges, I'll run a quick smoke: 1) staging docsite linkcheck, 2) run the k6 429 repro, 3) smoke the Python snippet locally. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall.

maya: Link PR preview looks clean. Tagging `docs-owners` for a quick :eyes:.

sam: pushed a small follow-up to #9014 replacing `X-Retry-After` with `Retry-After` examples and added a short note on respecting server-specified values vs. client backoff.

alex: Thanks all. If anything slips, we can do a small rollback of the docsite preview. Otherwise plan to merge by Friday midday. :thumbsup:
